$comment: AUTHORITY for the words of the Archivist's own refusals and of the messages it logs that a reader of its output relies on (ARCHIVIST.md), word for word. A text's `{name}` is filled as the row's `situation` says, and nothing else in it varies. `boot` is each refusal to start of the Archivist's own, beside the document and account refusals of service-environment/boot-refusals.json: written in that table's `line`, once, to stderr, before it exits with that table's `exitCode`; unlike those, these name what the Archivist was pointed at, the gateway and the working tree. `unsent` is the failure a reply that cannot be sent is answered with instead, on the operation's failure channel. `refusals` is each refusal of an operation, the `message` of its failure, and its `code` where it carries one; `{channel}` is the operation's request channel. `unauthorized` is the refusal of every route of the HTTP surface but `/health`. `http` is each other error a route answers with: its status and the body's `error`, and its `code` where the body carries one. `logged` is each message the Archivist logs, at its `level`, with the fields named in `fields`, each of the form given.

boot.name: no-project-file
boot.situation: The working tree commits no `.xynolog/config.yaml`, so it declares no `site.domain` (step 3).
boot.refusal: The knowledge base commits no .xynolog/config.yaml, so declares no site.domain: it is the identity this knowledge base acts under, and the audience it accepts tokens for

boot.name: not-a-checkout
boot.situation: The project file says `git.sync` is true, and git cannot be run in the root or says it is not inside a work tree (step 6): `{root}` is the document's `root`, and `{why}` git's or the system's reason, which varies.
boot.refusal: The knowledge base's project file says git.sync is true, and {root} is not a git checkout ({why}). Make it one (git init), or set git.sync to false.

boot.name: gateway-silent
boot.situation: The gateway does not answer its protected-resource metadata (step 5): `{gateway}` is the document's `gatewayUrl`, and `{reason}` why, which varies.
boot.refusal: The gateway at {gateway} did not say which knowledge base it serves (/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource): {reason}

boot.name: gateway-elsewhere
boot.situation: The gateway serves another knowledge base than the tree (step 5): `{gateway}` is the document's `gatewayUrl`, `{served}` the `resource` its metadata names, `{root}` the document's `root`, `{tree}` the tree's audience (`https://<domain>`, each `:` written `/`), and `{did}` the tree's DID.
boot.refusal: The gateway at {gateway} serves {served}, and the tree at {root} is {tree} ({did})

unsent.name: too-large
unsent.situation: A reply whose JSON is larger than a bus message may be: `{bytes}` is its size in bytes, and `{maxBodyBytes}` `POST /bus/emit`'s `x-xynolog-limits.maxBodyBytes` in the gateway's API.
unsent.message: The answer could not be sent: it is {bytes} bytes, and a bus message may be {maxBodyBytes}

unsent.name: not-sent
unsent.situation: Any other reply that cannot be sent, once the transport gives up: `{why}` is why, which varies.
unsent.message: The answer could not be sent: {why}

refusals.name: uncited-worker
refusals.situation: A sender holding the worker role whose command cites no `jobId`.
refusals.message: {channel} refused: a worker-role emitter must cite the job it fulfils in `jobId`

refusals.name: unassigned-job
refusals.situation: A command citing a job that the log of the resource it is checked against holds no `job:assigned` of, and that did not make the resource: `{jobId}` is the cited job, and `{resourceId}` that resource.
refusals.message: {channel} refused: cites job {jobId}, but the log of {resourceId} holds no assignment of it, and the job did not make it

refusals.name: not-the-holder
refusals.situation: A command citing a job whose recorded holder is not its sender: `{jobId}` is the cited job, `{holder}` the assignment's `holder` or the sender of the `yield:created` the job made, and `{writer}` the command's sender.
refusals.message: {channel} refused: job {jobId}'s recorded holder is {holder}, not the writer {writer}

refusals.name: sourceless-create
refusals.situation: A `yield:create` that cites a job and names no `generatedFrom.resourceId`.
refusals.message: yield:create refused: a create citing a job must name the source resource its job was assigned on (generatedFrom.resourceId)

refusals.name: multi-agent-create
refusals.situation: A `yield:create` whose `generator` is a list.
refusals.message: yield:create refused: a multi-agent generator is not supported; derivation binds one generator to the executor

refusals.name: generator-not-executor
refusals.situation: A supplied generator that is not the command's sender: `{generator}` is the generator's `@id`, and `{executor}` the sender.
refusals.message: {channel} refused: generator {generator} is not the executor {executor}

refusals.name: executor-not-software
refusals.situation: A supplied generator from a sender that is not software: `{executor}` is the sender.
refusals.message: {channel} refused: a generator was supplied, but the executor {executor} is not software

refusals.name: annotation-with-creator
refusals.situation: An annotation that arrives with a `creator`: `{annotationId}` is its `id`.
refusals.message: {channel} refused: `creator` on annotation {annotationId} is derived by the knowledge base, never sent

refusals.name: multi-agent-annotation
refusals.situation: An annotation whose `generator` is a list: `{annotationId}` is its `id`.
refusals.message: {channel} refused: annotation {annotationId} carries a multi-agent generator; derivation binds one generator to the executor

refusals.name: not-annotatable
refusals.situation: A target whose resource's content cannot be annotated: `{mediaType}` is its media type.
refusals.message: "{mediaType}" cannot be annotated

refusals.name: storage-uri-scheme
refusals.situation: A storage URI that does not begin `file://`: `{uri}` is the URI.
refusals.message: Invalid storage URI (must start with file://): {uri}

refusals.name: storage-uri-outside
refusals.situation: A storage URI naming a place outside the working tree: `{uri}` is the URI.
refusals.message: Invalid storage URI (must name a file inside the working tree): {uri}

refusals.name: checksum-mismatch
refusals.situation: Content registered whose file is not the checksum expected: `{uri}` is the URI, `{expected}` the first 8 characters of the checksum expected, and `{actual}` the first 8 of the file's.
refusals.message:
Checksum mismatch for {uri}: expected {expected}... but got {actual}...
The file on disk differs from the recorded checksum. Has it been modified since staging?

refusals.name: unarchive-without-file
refusals.situation: A `mark:unarchive` naming a storage URI with no file at it: `{uri}` is the URI.
refusals.message: Cannot unarchive: file not found at {uri}

refusals.name: entity-type-not-registered
refusals.situation: Types to add that are not in the vocabulary: `{types}` is each that is not, in the order the command names them, joined by `, `.
refusals.message: Entity type not registered: {types}

refusals.name: resource-not-found
refusals.situation: A resource with no events.
refusals.message: Resource not found

refusals.name: annotation-not-found
refusals.situation: An annotation the resource's view does not hold.
refusals.message: Annotation not found

refusals.name: path-escapes
refusals.situation: A path outside the working tree.
refusals.message: path escapes project root

refusals.name: path-not-found
refusals.situation: A path of the working tree that is not there.
refusals.message: path not found

refusals.name: clone-source-not-found
refusals.situation: A token asked for a resource with no view.
refusals.message: Resource not found

refusals.name: clone-content-not-found
refusals.situation: A token asked for a resource whose content is not in the working tree.
refusals.message: Resource content not found

refusals.name: invalid-token
refusals.situation: A token the Archivist did not issue, or has forgotten or spent.
refusals.message: Invalid or expired token

refusals.name: token-expired
refusals.situation: A token issued more than fifteen minutes before.
refusals.message: Token expired

refusals.name: token-source-not-found
refusals.situation: A token whose resource is no longer held.
refusals.message: Source resource not found

http.name: stream-listing-failed
http.situation: A listing of the log's streams that failed.

http.name: events-bad-request
http.situation: A `fromSequence` that is not an integer of at least 1 in decimal digits, or an id that is not one.
http.error: resourceId path segment and integer fromSequence >= 1 are required

http.name: event-read-failed
http.situation: A read of the stream that failed.

http.name: content-read-failed
http.situation: A file missing from the working tree.

http.name: content-no-resource
http.situation: No view of the resource: `{id}` is the path's id.

http.name: content-no-representation
http.situation: A view with no storage URI: `{id}` is the path's id.
http.error: Resource representation not found: no storageUri for {id}

http.name: annotations-not-found
http.situation: No view of the resource, or an id that is not one.

http.name: anchored-text-read-failed
http.situation: A read of the store that failed.

http.name: anchored-text-not-a-write
http.situation: A body that is not an AnchoredTextWrite: `{why}` is why, which varies.

http.name: anchored-text-write-not-found
http.situation: No view of the resource, or an id that is not one.

http.name: anchored-text-stored-not-found
http.situation: No view of the resource, or an id that is not one.

http.name: anchored-text-no-entry
http.situation: No entry stored for the resource's content under the stamp stated.
http.error: No entry is stored for this content

http.name: upload-unattributed
http.error: Xynolog-Principal is required: the record attributes every resource to someone

http.name: upload-unsupported-media
http.situation: A `format` whose media type is not one Xynolog knows: `{type}` is the media type.

http.name: upload-key-reused
http.situation: An `Idempotency-Key` whose resource was recorded from other fields or other bytes, a copy's key sent with no clone token, or a new resource's sent with one.
http.error: This Idempotency-Key names a resource recorded from other fields or other bytes

http.name: upload-refused
http.situation: A record that is refused: `{refusal}` is the refusal's message, as `refusals` states it for `yield:create`, or `yield:clone-create` with a clone token.

logged.name: not-an-event
logged.situation: A line of the log that is not an event, found when the views are rebuilt: `{path}` is its event file's path, and `{line}` its line number, counted from 1.
logged.message: The event log holds something that is not an event

logged.name: generated-not-linked
logged.situation: A generated resource recorded, whose link from the annotation it was generated for could not be recorded.
logged.message: A generated resource was not linked from its annotation

logged.name: completion-of-another-verb
logged.situation: A `job:complete` whose `jobType` is not the one the stream records for the job, which is not recorded.
logged.message: job:complete of another verb than the job's
